triggers.detailsText: Polycab India Limited (‘the Company’), has admitted a petition filed under Section 9 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 ("IBC") for initiation of the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process ("CIRP") against the Company in respect of an alleged operational debt of ₹2.79 crore. The Company, in consultation with its legal advisors, is of the opinion that it has a strong case with good grounds of appeal, including that of it being a commercial dispute, to challenge the order for admission of CIRP against the Company. The Company continues to hold a zero-debt position with the cash / investment liquidity and its Balance Sheet continues to remain strong with net cash position in excess of Rs4,000 crores and net-worth of Rs11,682 crores as per the audited financial statements for the year ended 31st March 2026.
filingKeyFacts: Polycab India Limited (‘the Company’), has admitted a petition filed under Section 9 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 ("IBC") for initiation of the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process ("CIRP") against the Company in respect of an alleged operational debt of ₹2.79 crore.

The Company, in consultation with its legal advisors, is of the opinion that it has a strong case with good grounds of appeal, including that of it being a commercial dispute, to challenge the order for admission of CIRP against the Company.

The Company continues to hold a zero-debt position with the cash / investment liquidity and its Balance Sheet continues to remain strong with net cash position in excess of Rs4,000 crores and net-worth of Rs11,682 crores as per the audited financial statements for the year ended 31st March 2026.

triggers.detailsText: CARE Ratings Limited (CareEdge Ratings) expects moderation in BOB’s profitability in FY27 affected largely by one-time provision of ₹5,680 crore related to out-of-court settlement with the joint administrators of NMC Health PLC, NMC Healthcare Limited and NMC Holding Limited. The non-interest income decreased marginally by ~0.2% y-o -y due to decrease in recovery from written-off accounts 3 CARE Ratings Ltd Press Release partially which was partially offset by increase in treasury income and dividend income in FY26. Operating expenses to total assets decreased to 1.66% of average total assets in FY26 compared to 1.79% for the previous year.
filingKeyFacts: CARE Ratings Limited (CareEdge Ratings) expects moderation in BOB’s profitability in FY27 affected largely by one-time provision of ₹5,680 crore related to out-of-court settlement with the joint administrators of NMC Health PLC, NMC Healthcare Limited and NMC Holding Limited.

The non-interest income decreased marginally by ~0.2% y-o -y due to decrease in recovery from written-off accounts 3 CARE Ratings Ltd Press Release partially which was partially offset by increase in treasury income and dividend income in FY26.
